trails.name: Atlantic Forest Trail - Parana's Mountains
trails.why: The Atlantic Forest Trail is a Brazilian trail that crosses the Serra do Mar and part of the Serra geral, whose predominant ecosystem is the Atlantic Forest.

trails.name: Caminho do Itupava
trails.why: The Caminho do Itupava is a historical trail that connects Curitiba to Morretes, in the Brazilian state of Paraná.

trails.name: Caminhada Vale do Selke
trails.why: Annual event advertised on the website.

trails.name: Caminhada Ribeirão Souto
trails.why: Annual event advertised on the website.

trails.name: Torre da Prata
trails.why: Attention to the visitor registration procedure Before going to the track: a- Read the Terms of Risk and Standards of the Silver Tower Track b- Fill in the Cadast form...

trails.name: Trilha Pedra Santa
trails.region: Instituto Chico Mendes de Conservação da Biodiversidade
trails.why: It passes through the Monk's Grotto, the White Stone and the Monument to Varnhagen.

trails.name: Pico da Bandeira near Espera Feliz
trails.why: Pico da Bandeira, or Bandeira Peak is the third highest mountain in Brazil, situated on the border of Espírito Santo and Minas Gerais states.

trails.name: Pedra da Mina summit
trails.why: Pedra da Mina is the fourth highest mountain in Brazil, located in the Serra Fina section of the Mantiqueira Mountains, one of the country's most important mountain ranges.

trails.name: Pico das Agulhas Negras
trails.why: The peak of the Black Agulhas, at an altitude of 2,790.94 m, is the highest point in the state of Rio de Janeiro, the third highest point in the state of Minas Gerais, and the fifth highest in Brazil.

trails.name: Pico do Cristal
trails.why: Cristal Peak is the sixth highest Brazilian peak, with an altitude of 2,769.05 meters, according to the measurement made by IBGE and the Military Engineering Institute, through the Project Culminantes do Brasil, and reviewed by IBGE through new mapping...

trails.name: Mount Roraima
trails.why: Highest mountain in Guyana. Inspired Sir Arthur Conan Doyle to write his classic adventure novel, The Lost World, 1912.

trails.name: Pico dos Três Estados
trails.why: Pico dos Três Estados is a mountain peak at which the three Brazilian states of Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, and São Paulo all meet, respectively in the municipalities of Passa Quatro, Resende and Queluz.

trails.name: Pico dos Marins
trails.why: Pico dos Marins is a mountain peak in Brazil, between the cities of Piquete and Cruzeiro, state of São Paulo.

trails.name: Pico do Itaguaré
trails.why: Itaguaré Peak is a mountain located in the border of the states of Minas Gerais and São Paulo, in the Serra da Mantiqueira.

trails.name: Bell Stone summit
trails.why: The Bellstone, at 2,275 meters above sea level, is the high point of Serra dos Orgãos National Park.

trails.name: Pedra do Açu summit
trails.why: Pedra Açu is a geographic accident located between Petrópolis and Teresópolis, it has an altitude of 2,236 meters.

trails.name: Serra do Papagaio summit
trails.why: The Serra do Papagaio State Park is a state park in the state of Minas Gerais, Brazil. It protects a mountainous region of Atlantic Forest.

trails.name: Forno Grande summit
trails.why: The peak of the Forno Grande, at 2039 meters in altitude, is the second highest peak of the Holy Spirit and the highest of the Castle mountain range.

trails.name: Pico do Barbado
trails.why: Pico do Barbado is the highest mountain in the Brazilian state of Bahia, and the highest in all Northeastern Brazil, reaching 2,033 metres above sea level.

trails.name: Pico do Itambé
trails.why: Itambé Peak rises to 2,052 meters in the Serra do Espinhaço, in the state of Minas Gerais, between the municipalities of Serro and Santo Antônio do Itambé.

trails.name: Pico das Almas
trails.why: The Pico das Almas, located in the Serra das Almas, marks the dividing line between the municipalities of Livramento de Nossa Senhora and Rio de Contas in the Chapada Diamantina, central region of the Brazilian state of Bahia.

trails.name: Itobira's peak
trails.why: Itobira Peak is one of the highest points in the Brazilian state of Bahia, with an altitude of 1970m.

trails.name: Pico do Itacolomi
trails.why: Itacolomi Peak is an altitude rock formation located on the border of the municipalities of Mariana and Ouro Preto, in Minas Gerais.

trails.name: Capivari Grande summit
trails.why: The Pico Capivari Grande is an elevation located in the Brazilian municipality of Campina Grande do Sul, in the state of Paraná.

trails.name: Pico do Frade
trails.why: Pico do Frade is the highest point in the municipality of Macaé, in the state of Rio de Janeiro.

trails.name: Pico do Papagaio
trails.why: Papagaio Peak is a 990-meter high mountain located in Ilha Grande, in the state of Rio de Janeiro, near the city of Angra dos Reis.

trails.name: Monte Crista
trails.why: Monte Crista is located in the municipality of Garuva, on the northern coast of the state of Santa Catarina at approximately 927 meters above sea level, on the slopes of the Serra do Mar, near the municipality of Joinville, about 40 km from where Curitiba goes, to...

trails.name: Morro Spitzkopf
trails.why: Spitzkopf Hill is a mountain in the Brazilian municipality of Blumenau, with an altitude of 938 meters.

trails.name: Mestre Álvaro summit
trails.why: Mestre Álvaro is considered one of the largest coastal elevations on the Brazilian coast and is home to one of the last areas of the Atlantic Forest at the altitude of Espírito Santo.

trails.name: Morro do Baú
trails.why: The Baú Hill is a 819-meter-high hill located in the Brazilian state of Santa Catarina.

trails.name: Pico do Cabugi
trails.why: The Pico do Cabugi, also known as the Serra do Cabuji or Serrote da Itaretama, is the only extinct volcano in Brazil which preserves its original form.

trails.name: Morro do Ribeirão
trails.why: Ribeirão hill, with an altitude of 532m, is the highest point on the island of Santa Catarina, in the Brazilian state of Santa Catarina.

trails.name: Cachoeira da Fumaça waterfall
trails.why: The Cachoeira da Fumaça is 340 m tall waterfall in Bahia, Brazil. It was believed to be the country's highest waterfall until the 353 m tall Cachoeira do Araca was recently discovered in the Amazon.

trails.name: Cambirela Sul summit
trails.why: Morro do Cambirela is a mountain located in the same name, in the municipality of Palhoça, in the state of Santa Catarina.

trails.name: Pousada Antonio hut
trails.why: 20 bed bedroom, very rustic but perfectly authentic, meals and refreshments.

trails.name: Salto Rio Vermelho Parte Alta
trails.why: In the event of an accident, it is necessary to look for a local residence with internet access to call for help.
